description: Header audit: HTML page without HSTS, CSP or framing protection, a cookie without Secure/HttpOnly, and plain HTTP serving content.

expected.title: HTTPS site does not send Strict-Transport-Security
expected.description: The HTTPS response to / has no Strict-Transport-Security header.

expected.title: No Content-Security-Policy
expected.description: The HTML response to / has no Content-Security-Policy header.

expected.title: Page can be framed by other sites
expected.description: The HTML response to / sends neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

expected.title: Cookie PHPSESSID is set without the Secure flag
expected.description: The HTTPS response sets cookie PHPSESSID without Secure.

expected.title: Cookie PHPSESSID is readable by page scripts
expected.description: Cookie PHPSESSID is set without HttpOnly. That's correct for cookies the page's own scripts read; it's a weakness for session cookies.

expected.title: Plain HTTP is not redirected to HTTPS
expected.description: http://www.lab.test/ answered 200 instead of redirecting to HTTPS.
